description: Updated benchmark workload to disable accidental default-interest/urban filtering and produce non-zero result counts; this is a benchmark quality fix and new baseline, not a regression.

asi.hypothesis: Benchmark should include explicit neutral filter values so it measures realistic search behavior and preserves correctness signal.
asi.target_change: Workload semantics changed (total_results from 0 to 1095), so metric history before this run is not directly comparable.
asi.next_action_hint: Re-initialize experiment baseline for corrected workload, then optimize filtering/sorting hot paths.

name: Optimize students search endpoint latency (corrected workload)

description: New corrected-workload baseline: median total search batch latency ~943.8ms with stable non-zero result volume.

asi.hypothesis: Establish baseline after workload correction before optimization.
asi.next_action_hint: Optimize hot filter path allocations and repeated string normalization in utils/search_filters.py.

description: Added per-case timing metrics to benchmark output to localize hotspots; data shows free-text case dominates runtime.

asi.hypothesis: Expose median timing per workload case to guide targeted optimization.
asi.insight: free_text_ms (~376ms) is the largest component; baseline_all and structured_filters are ~268-272ms each, favorites is cheap.
asi.next_action_hint: Optimize free-text matcher to avoid repeated normalization and expensive checks when query terms are unchanged across students.

description: Optimized search response shaping by converting only paginated students to BasicStudent instead of converting the full sorted result list.

asi.hypothesis: Avoid unnecessary model_dump/BasicStudent construction for non-returned rows to reduce per-query CPU and allocations.
asi.impact: Largest wins expected on broad-result queries; free_text remains dominant hotspot.
asi.next_action_hint: Target free-text fuzzy matcher overhead by reducing repeated processing of query and student text fields.

description: Added repository-level cache for all full students (with invalidation on student_full_view mutations), eliminating repeated DB row mapping on repeated searches.

asi.hypothesis: Cold filtering cost is dominated by repeatedly loading and decoding all students from SQLite; cache the parsed student objects safely.
asi.impact: Massive latency drop by removing repeated get_all_full_students DB work; free_text now dominates remaining time.
asi.safety: Cache is cleared in insert_full_student, update_student_status_full, and random status-switch mutation path.
asi.next_action_hint: Optimize remaining free_text_ms (~100ms) and consider targeted caching for parsed free-text fields.

description: Memoized normalized free-text field bundles with an LRU cache keyed by student text content, reducing repeated preprocessing across repeated searches.

asi.hypothesis: After caching full student objects, remaining free-text cost is repeated field normalization; cache normalized bundles per unique student content.
asi.impact: free_text_ms dropped further (~99.9 -> ~93.4) while result counts stayed stable.
asi.next_action_hint: Investigate eliminating expensive char-wise favorite_subjects join in free-text matching if behavior can be preserved.
